Application Data.NAME: WoodWorks Carpentry, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: WoodWorks Carpentry, LLC specializes in custom woodworking and carpentry services, including the design, fabrication, and installation of cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork. Our operations focus on high-quality craftsmanship using sustainably sourced materials, with an emphasis on safety protocols and environmental responsibility. We undertake both residential and commercial projects, ensuring compliance with local building codes and safety regulations. We also offer repair and refinishing services for existing wood products, employing trained staff to mitigate risks and maintain a clean safety record.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2023, WoodWorks Carpentry, LLC experienced a loss due to a minor fire that occurred during a cabinetry installation. The fire was caused by a malfunctioning power tool and resulted in damages amounting to $5,000. The fire department was called, and the event was documented. The cleanup and repairs have been completed, and the incident is currently closed. Additionally, on 05/10/2022, a client reported damage to custom furniture during transit, leading to a claim of $5,500, which is also resolved with no further outstanding issues.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing with video surveillance and regular security patrols.
